item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: Students in grades 9-12 that are looking to make changes to their schedule, please see Mrs. Marcellus in the Guidance Office to sign up for an appointment. Teams messages and drop in's will not be accepted at this time.

item.title: A message from Mr. Warner.
item.description: Anyone interested in trying out for junior or senior girls' basketball should sign up in the gym foyer. Junior girls' tryouts are Thursday September 3rd and Friday September 4th after school. Senior girls' tryouts are Wednesday September 9th and Friday September 11th after school. Please message Mr. Warner on Teams if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mr. Charlebois.
item.description: Anyone interested in running cross country this year, please meet in room 106 at 11. Tryouts will start tomorrow.

item.title: A message from Mr. Danby
item.description: For any boys in grades 9-12 who are interested in trying out for the soccer team. There will a meeting in portable 315 on Thursday at 11.

item.title: A message from Mrs. Marcellus
item.description: The full transportation listing has been posted in TEAMS for you to access in the event you have a student who does not know their bus route number. As well, a list of the bus waves has been put in your mailbox and is also posted in Teams.

item.title: A message from Mr. Kwok
item.description: Any high school girl who is interested in playing soccer this year is asked to sign up on a sheet in the gym foyer. Information about tryouts is on the sheet. Please reach out to Mr. Kwok if you have any questions

item.title: A message from Mr. Kwok
item.description: Any high school student interested in helping out with the creation of the yearbook is asked to come to portable 316 at lunch on FRIDAY for an informational meeting.
